answer.book: Ockam's Dialogus in Goldast's edition: a dialogue divided into three parts, each of books, tractatus and numbered chapters; this sheet holds books III to VII of part I, the proem and second tractatus of part II, and the first tractatus of part III from its first liber to the start of liber III (the sheet ends there).
